title: Naramata Private Wine Tour - Half Day
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Only 19 yrs of age & above are allowed to drink alcoholic beverages
policies: Transportation Zone for pickup/.dropoff is Penticton, Summerland, Kaleden & Peachland. Outside this regular transportation zone there is an added transportation surcharge.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Naramata Bench bathed in sunshine with cooling lake breezes and optimal temperatures creates a premier grape growing region in Canada. 

The rolling hills and variable soils with a range of microclimates and terroir produce a variety of premium grapes - Reds include Pinot Noir, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz and Malbec. Whites also thrive in the Naramata terroir including Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Gewurztraminer, Semillon and Sauvignon Blanc.
